summary: Agent Studio supplies a concrete task/run/envelope implementation; observability and provenance standards provide adjacent evidence for correlation and artifact verification.

items.text: Agent Studio resource contracts and immutable result-envelope digest at a pinned public commit.
Agent Studio's per-task timeline record carries RunId correlation and payload references in a closed event model.
Agent Studio canonicalizes and hashes immutable result-envelope fields, including source attempt, repository commits and artifact-manifest identity.
Agent Studio durable handoff recovery replays journaled transfer facts idempotently before new claims without launching the coding agent again.
OpenTelemetry Signals: traces, logs and their shared contextual correlation.
SLSA provenance and artifact verification connect build claims to immutable subjects and trusted provenance.
Langfuse prompt-to-trace links demonstrate how an exact prompt version remains addressable from an execution trace.
